                                  ANIMAL
                                  SHLTR
DATA FOR CALCULATIONS

Raw data available upon request.

INTAKE STATISTICS are used to identify the percentage of animals
received from each jurisdiction relative to total intake.

  Animal intake data is used to calculate animal boarding and care,
veterinary services,and support services as a proportion of the overall cost
to house, manage, and care for animals received within the framework of
the contracts.

       Animal Intakes Included:

   • All stray animals from within the city/county
   • Animals surrendered to, or brought in by, animal control and/or PD.
   • All DOA

       Animal Intakes Excluded:

   •   Transfers-in from other agencies
   •   Returned adoptions
   •   Owner surrenders that were later adopted
   •   All animals from outside jurisdictions
   •   Animals serviced-in for other programs (animal and community health
       -Safety Net Services, public vaccines and/or spay and neuter
       services)
